name: Magus Lantern Warrior
body:
Diminished Spellcasting

A lantern warrior casts one fewer spell of each level than normal.

Order (Ex)

At 1st level, pledges to a cavalier order as a cavalier of her magus level, gaining skills, edicts, and abilities at the appropriate levels (without the challenge feature until 4th level).

Challenge (Ex)

At 4th level, gains the cavalier’s challenge feature using her magus level. Replaces spell recall.
